name: Govseer Quebec Label Check
author: govseer

sections.description:
Since 1 June 2025, the generic and descriptive words on a product sold in Quebec must appear in French, even when they are part of an English trademark (Charter of the French language, sections 51 and 51.1). Products made before that date may be sold as they are only until 1 June 2027.

Govseer Quebec Label Check, on each product’s edit screen:

  • reads the package’s artwork (by default the product’s image and gallery; or the PDF or image files you choose, up to 6 panels),
  • sorts every text into what must also be in French and what may stay in another language: safety information, generic and descriptive terms, trademarks, names and the rest, each finding with its legal reference,
  • asks three questions that change the result: where the product is made, whether it was made before 1 June 2025, and whether a French version of the trademark is registered. Changing an answer re-checks the label for free,
  • checks the federal basics for prepackaged products: common name and net quantity in English and French, and the dealer’s name and address,
  • writes the translation brief for your designer, with a suggested Quebec French wording for each text (paid plans and packs),
  • shows in the products list which products still need French.

Results are re-run on the current rules each time you open a product. The plugin’s screens are in English and French.

The plugin needs a Govseer account. The free plan includes three labels a month; paid plans and packs are on govseer.com/pricing. If you also use Govseer Hazard Labels, the same API key works for both.

This plugin gives findings against Quebec’s and Canada’s published rules. It is not a certificate and not legal advice: the Office québécois de la langue française decides. Have suggested French wording checked before printing.

External services

This plugin uses the Govseer API (https://govseer-api-823928849037.europe-west1.run.app), run by Govseer, to read label artwork and check it.

  • When you click “Check this label”, the artwork files and your three answers are sent to the API. The files are read once and not stored; the text read from them and your answers are kept on your Govseer account, so results can be re-run and you can see them on govseer.com.
  • When you open a checked product or change an answer, the check’s id (and the new answers) are sent to get the current result.

  • Your API key is sent with every request. Nothing about your customers is ever sent.

  • When you open the plugin’s settings page, it reads Govseer’s public list of upcoming rule changes for this product (https://govseer-api-823928849037.europe-west1.run.app/api/v1/upcoming-rules), sending only your admin language. No API key, shop or customer data is sent. The list is kept for 12 hours.

Privacy notice: https://govseer.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin (WooCommerce must be active).
  2. Create a free account at govseer.com/account and create an API key under “API keys”. Copy it; it is shown once.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Quebec labels and paste the API key (not needed if Govseer Hazard Labels already has one). Save.
  4. Open a product. In the “Quebec label check (French)” box, check the artwork (the product’s images are used unless you choose other files), answer the three questions and click “Check this label”.
